programs.desc: We will see a traffic light in Wrocław with a broken green light, a complicated left turn into a fence in Świdnica and a railway crossing connecting a meadow with an orchard in Belsk Mały.Kamil and Krzysiek will see an installation resembling an anti-missile shield at the roundabout in Pionki, a wrongly placed sign informing about a pedestrian crossing in Skaryszew and a closed access road in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski.In Suchedniów - on a short road in a housing estate of single-family houses, there are too many pedestrian crossings.We will also focus on the ban on traffic in the middle of a field in Wielka Wola, the Rzeszów markings allowing drivers to drive in a straight line, Legnica street lamps in the middle of the sidewalk and a dangerous intersection in Środa Śląska, where screens significantly reduce visibility.
